load("hsPBMC") 

cicero.gene_activity_matrix <- read.table("R.cicero.gene_activity_matrix.txt")

row.names(cicero.gene_activity_matrix) <- row.names(fd)
colnames(cicero.gene_activity_matrix) <- row.names(pd)

my_cds_obj <- newCellDataSet(as.matrix(cicero.gene_activity_matrix),
                       phenoData = pd, featureData = fd)

my_cds_obj <- estimateSizeFactors(my_cds_obj)

#Classify Cells

library(org.Hs.eg.db)
my_cds_obj <- classify_cells(my_cds_obj, hsPBMC,
                           db = org.Hs.eg.db,
                           cluster_extend = TRUE,
                           cds_gene_id_type = "ALIAS")
